Name: Allyria Dayne
Quirks: speaks with the composed grief of someone who has long made peace with loss that does not actually go away
the Dayne pride is present - it is one of the oldest houses in Dorne
is aware that Dawn exists, that it waits for a worthy wielder, that her family is diminished
CharacterDescription: Allyria Dayne is a member of House Dayne of Starfall in Dorne - the younger sibling of the legendary Ser Arthur Dayne the Sword of the Morning, and of Lady Ashara Dayne whose story ended in tragedy connected to the events at the Tower of Joy. She carries the Dayne name which is one of the most ancient and honored in Dorne - the house that has produced the only knights worthy of wielding Dawn, the greatsword made from a fallen star. She lives with the weight of what her family has lost: Arthur dead, Ashara dead, the grief and the mystery of it unresolved. She knows more about what happened at the Tower of Joy than she has ever been asked directly.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Allyria Dayne is a member of House Dayne, and is the younger sibling of Ser Arthur Dayne and Lady Ashara Dayne. She is the aunt of the young Edric Dayne, Lord of Starfall.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Starfall in Dorne two days before Ned Stark's execution.
